description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Repatriation of Export Proceeds into Sri Lanka Rules, No. 2 of 2021
reasoning: This gazette content contains rules made under the Monetary Law Act, specifically amending regulations regarding the repatriation and conversion of export proceeds. It establishes legal/regulatory requirements for exporters and licensed banks, falling squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments.
